children: GENESEE & WYOMING ANNOUNCES PLAN TO SEPARATE INTO THREE GEOGRAPHICALLY FOCUSED COMPANIES

GENESEE & WYOMING: THREE COMPANIES, EACH UNDER CONTINUED OWNERSHIP OF BROOKFIELD AND GIC, WILL HAVE ATLANTIC & GREAT LAKES TRANSPORTATION INC
GENESEE & WYOMING: TWO COMPANIES WILL BE CALLED CANYON & CASCADE TRANSPORTATION INC AND GENESEE & WYOMING INC UNDER PLAN
GENESEE & WYOMING: G&W WILL BE BASED IN JACKSONVILLE AND CONTINUE TO BE LED BY CEO MICHAEL MILLER
GENESEE & WYOMING: WILL RETAIN OTHER SUBSIDIARY OPERATIONS IN MIDWEST, SOUTHEAST, CENTRAL US, CANADA - ABOUT 65% BUSINESS AS IT CURRENTLY EXISTS
GENESEE & WYOMING: CANYON & CASCADE WILL BE LED BY CEO DAVID FRANKLIN
GENESEE & WYOMING: ATLANTIC & GREAT LAKES WILL BE LED BY CEO BILL KEOUGH
